note: Inase's battle suit on the family's nude body (a01, RoeNudeBody: it replaces the suit's skin, which the game cut away under the armour), so every piece can come off. Stage 1: the skirt round the hips - the two long panels, the hip armour they hang from, the chains, the back flap, the small pieces at the waist. Stage 2: the upper armour - the left shoulder armour with its chain, the collar, the chain round the right upper arm. Stage 3: the limb armour - forearm guards (with the links on the left forearm and the tassel at the left wrist), shin guards, sandals. Stage 4: the bra armour and the crotch guard. Stays on: the crown, the earring, the rings. The bra armour follows the body (followBody: the nude body's weights under it, so a breast spring moves skin and cup together - RoeBodyCheck 10-05). The first rule that matches a piece decides; pieces no rule matches stay on.
